evals.name: freeze-journey-boundaries
evals.prompt: Conçois un service où un salarié trouve un mentor puis réserve son premier échange.
evals.expected_output: Playback target, outcome, exact start/end boundaries, shared scenario, success criterion, evidence level, framework and design system before ideation.

evals.name: missing-outcome-one-question
evals.prompt: Je veux refaire notre portail RH.
evals.expected_output: Ask exactly one focused question that resolves target context, intended outcome and observable success without a questionnaire.

evals.name: multi-persona-service-blueprint
evals.prompt: Crée un service de mentoring pour mentees, mentors et RH.
evals.expected_output: Require a shared service boundary and blueprint before selecting one persona slice; label unsupported claims as assumptions.

evals.name: single-screen-routing
evals.prompt: Conçois uniquement le contenu d'une modale d'annulation existante; le résultat doit aider l'utilisateur à confirmer ou revenir.
evals.expected_output: Recognize a single-screen target and route to same-screen visual ideation rather than journey boards.
